components.name: jpetstore
components.application_server: External servlet container — Apache Tomcat 9.0.120 by default (Maven profile 'tomcat9'); alternatives via Maven profiles: Apache TomEE, WildFly, WebSphere Liberty, Eclipse Jetty, GlassFish, Payara, Resin
components.runtime: Java 17 web application (WAR) — requires an external servlet container
runtime_dependencies: Embedded HSQL in-memory database (no external DB by default)

workload_mappings.rationale: Stateless Java web application (WAR) on an external servlet container; horizontally scalable behind a Service. Uses an in-process in-memory database, so replicas do NOT share state — externalise the database before running more than one replica.

networking.subject: app.context_path
networking.kubernetes_effect: the app is served under '/jpetstore', not '/'. Ingress must route this path (or rename the WAR to ROOT); Service targetPort is unaffected.

configuration.subject: runtime.application_server
configuration.value: External servlet container — Apache Tomcat 9.0.120 by default (Maven profile 'tomcat9'); alternatives via Maven profiles: Apache TomEE, WildFly, WebSphere Liberty, Eclipse Jetty, GlassFish, Payara, Resin
configuration.kubernetes_effect: the app is NOT self-contained: it needs a servlet container. For K8s, bake the WAR into a fixed server image (e.g. tomcat:9-jre17) rather than downloading a server at runtime.

runtime_dependencies.subject: database.embedded
runtime_dependencies.kubernetes_effect: no external database is required by default. Data lives in the pod and is ephemeral; each replica has its own isolated copy. Externalise the DB (with JDBC config as ConfigMap/Secret) before scaling past 1 replica or needing durability.

startup_order.subject: startup.db_init
startup_order.kubernetes_effect: schema/seed SQL executed in-process at application startup; re-runs on every pod start (no separate migration Job for the embedded DB).

startup_order.subject: startup.db_init
startup_order.kubernetes_effect: schema/seed SQL executed in-process at application startup; re-runs on every pod start (no separate migration Job for the embedded DB).

container_image.subject: image.build_command
container_image.kubernetes_effect: produces the artifact during image build; needs network for dependency resolution

container_image.subject: image.runtime_server_download
container_image.kubernetes_effect: the servlet container is fetched from the internet on every start; pods need egress and startup is slow/non-reproducible. Build a fixed WAR-on-Tomcat image instead.

container_image.subject: image.signal_handling
container_image.value: Maven runs as PID 1 (shell form CMD)
container_image.kubernetes_effect: SIGTERM goes to the mvn/mvnw wrapper, not the JVM, so graceful shutdown and fast pod termination are not guaranteed. Use exec form / tini, or run the server directly.

container_image.subject: image.runs_as_root
container_image.kubernetes_effect: the container runs as root by default; set securityContext.runAsNonRoot / runAsUser and a non-root USER in the image.

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: readiness_liveness_probe
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: the repository defines no health/readiness endpoint (no Spring Boot Actuator, no compose healthcheck)
unresolved_operational_inputs.needed_input: an HTTP path or TCP port to probe (e.g. TCP 8080, or GET the context root once warm)

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: security_context_run_as_non_root
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: the image sets no USER; running as root is a deployment decision, not stated in the repo

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: graceful_shutdown
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: start command runs a shell/Maven wrapper as PID 1; signal propagation to the JVM is not guaranteed
unresolved_operational_inputs.needed_input: an exec-form entrypoint (or tini) and the app's termination behaviour

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: external_database_for_scaling
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: the app uses an in-process in-memory database; replicas cannot share state and data is ephemeral
unresolved_operational_inputs.needed_input: whether to externalise to a managed/in-cluster DB, and its connection details
unresolved_operational_inputs.kubernetes_effect: external DB Service + ConfigMap/Secret; enables replicas>1 and durability

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: replica_count
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: desired availability/throughput is an operational decision, not in the repo
unresolved_operational_inputs.needed_input: target replicas per Deployment (SLO / load expectations)

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: resource_requests_limits
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: repo contains no CPU/memory sizing information
unresolved_operational_inputs.needed_input: measured or estimated CPU/memory per component

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: ingress_class
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: cluster ingress controller is environment-specific and not declared in the repo
unresolved_operational_inputs.needed_input: target IngressClass in the destination cluster

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: horizontal_pod_autoscaler
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: no scaling policy is expressed in the repo

unresolved_operational_inputs.subject: pod_disruption_budget
unresolved_operational_inputs.reason: availability tolerance during disruptions is an operational decision

warnings.message: run command activates Maven profile 'tomcat90', which is not defined in the POM (defined: glassfish5, jetty, liberty-ee8, payara5, resin, tomcat9, tomee80, wildfly26). It resolves only because the default profile stays active; verify the intended server.
Dockerfile base image 'openjdk:25' targets Java 25, but the POM builds for Java 17. Align the runtime JDK to the build target to avoid class-version surprises.
